features.name: buying_level_norm
features.description: Buying-price ordinal code scaled to the fixed 0-3 span; higher values preserve the supplied code order.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth price-code axis with comparable scale for margin weights.

features.name: maintenance_level_norm
features.description: Maintenance-cost ordinal code scaled to the fixed 0-3 span; higher values preserve the supplied code order.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth upkeep-code axis with comparable scale for margin weights.

features.name: door_count_level_norm
features.description: Door-count ordinal code scaled to the fixed 0-3 span.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives the margin a compact access-related coordinate on the same scale as other engineered inputs.

features.name: passenger_capacity_norm
features.description: Passenger-capacity ordinal code scaled to the fixed 0-2 span.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies a stable seating-capacity axis that can receive a direct linear weight.

features.name: cargo_room_norm
features.description: Luggage-boot ordinal code scaled to the fixed 0-2 span.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a bounded cargo-capacity coordinate for comparable weighting.

features.name: safety_level_norm
features.description: Safety ordinal code scaled to the fixed 0-2 span.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a bounded safety coordinate that is easy for a linear margin to use.

features.name: practical_utility_weighted
features.description: Weighted continuous composite of seating, access, cargo, and safety ordinal levels.
features.expected_model_benefit: Approximates an interpretable linear projection of everyday usability while preserving a bounded scale.

features.name: safety_capacity_synergy
features.description: Product of normalized safety and seating capacity, high only when both component codes are high.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a simple interaction surface that a purely linear margin cannot form from separate axes alone.

features.name: core_inadequacy_severity
features.description: Worst normalized shortfall among seating, cargo, and safety, using the top code as zero shortfall.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights the strongest practical bottleneck as one continuous severity coordinate.

features.name: code_adjusted_utility_ratio
features.description: Weighted utility composite divided by one plus the combined buying and maintenance code level.
features.expected_model_benefit: Exposes a smooth tradeoff ratio between practical utility and ownership-code scale.

features.name: semantic_practicality_score
features.description: Assessor-provided 0-1 score for everyday practicality from door, seating, cargo, and safety ordinal levels; 0.0 means very limited, 1.0 means very practical.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures domain nuance in a bounded coordinate that can complement deterministic composites.

features.name: semantic_overall_balance_score
features.description: Assessor-provided 0-1 score for overall balance among buying, maintenance, seating, cargo, and safety ordinal levels; 0.0 means poorly balanced, 1.0 means strongly balanced.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a non-formulaic smooth projection of tradeoff quality for the margin.
